fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Confirmed General Mills Fridley plant ('Mill O'), 25 44th Avenue NE, Fridley MN - an oat-milling / flour-mill facility that cleans and mills oats for Cheerios and Lucky Charms. Multi-story concrete mill tower, large concrete grain elevator silos to the north, a long row of low metal grain-storage silos along the rail yard to the west, conveyor bridges, and bulk-handling structures. Located between the BNSF Northtown rail yard (west) and a residential neighborhood (east).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is a single wide open paved driveway off the public access road at the SE corner of the property. Street View (2022-06 and 2021-08) shows no barrier arm, no slide/swing gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point at the property line - the driveway opens directly onto the road. truckGate = false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the truck entrance in any Street View heading. A small structure near the mill building is an equipment/utility structure, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.railServed: Strongly rail-served. Multiple BNSF rail spurs run directly into the property along the western edge with covered hopper cars and boxcars parked at the silos and mill loadout; this is the primary inbound (grain) and outbound (bulk flour) mode for the mill.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Flour mill - ships/receives mostly via rail and bulk tanker truck, not palletized dock-door freight. Only a modest set of loading positions (estimated 6) along the mill building's south/east faces; no large dock-door bank. dockDoors band 0-10, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; the paved yard south and east of the mill is open working area. A few grain trailers / hopper trailers seen parked under the silo loadout. dropArea band 0-10.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep open paved yard between the entrance driveway and the mill building / silos provides interior queuing space.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance driveway runs a long distance from the public road into the property before reaching the mill and silo loadout - can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, immediately adjacent to dense residential fabric in Fridley - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Multi-structure mill campus: main mill tower, concrete grain elevator silos, low metal silo row, and a separate admin/shop building to the south - counted as ~4 distinct buildings.
fieldNotes.scale: Possible truck scale near the grain-receiving silo loadout but not clearly confirmed from imagery - listed uncertain.
